title: MandalaZ
description: This is an UNOFFICIAL addon to Mandala's GUI that aims to add Mandala's GUI support for LevelZ (versions 1.19.x, 1.20.x, and 1.21.x) and SkillZ
body:
# ABOUT:

Transforms LevelZ into the beautiful style of Mandala's Creations. 

# Features:

Supports multiple versions and multiple mods
-    LevelZ | 1.19.2, 1.20.x, and 1.21.1
-    JobAddon | 1.19.2, 1.20.x, and 1.21.1
-    PartyAddon | 1.19.2, 1.20.x, and 1.21.1
-    SkillZ | 1.20.1


Improves existing textures within LevelZ, such as the books

# Credit:
Inspired by and based on:
- Mandala's GUI - Dark mode | https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mandalas-gui-dark-mode
- Mandala's Gui - LevelZ Support | https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/levelz-mandalas-gui-support
